--- title: "Linemen and defensive backs lead a close drafted-rate pack, and quarterbacks go earliest on average" date: "2026-10-24" description: "Counting every rostered player, defensive and offensive linemen and defensive backs lead a close drafted-rate pack, quarterbacks sit mid-table yet lead round 1 and the average pick, and quarterbacks are the only group with fewer than half of NFL entrants undrafted." followups: - "Carry position as a feature in the models; the spread in drafted rates and the round mix are variance a pooled model would otherwise spend capacity on." - "Keep linemen on the roster population: restricted to linemen with a stat line, the line looked like the most drafted group by a wide margin." author: - "AI directed by Nick Giangreco" freeze: auto vignette: > %\VignetteIndexEntry{Linemen and defensive backs lead a close drafted-rate pack, and quarterbacks go earliest on average} %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html} %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8} --- ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Load the project's functions straight from the checkout with pkgload; the # repo is never installed (decision 0042). The site build sets CFB2NFL_ROOT, # a local render finds the checkout from the working directory. root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT") if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path() knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root) pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE) con <- DBI::dbConnect( duckdb::duckdb(), file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"), read_only = TRUE ) library(DBI) library(dplyr) library(duckdb) library(ggiraph) library(ggplot2) library(knitr) library(tibble) library(tidyr) set_girafe_defaults( opts_hover = opts_hover( css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2.5px;filter:brightness(1.12);" ), opts_hover_inv = opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"), opts_tooltip = opts_tooltip( css = "background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;" ), opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 5), opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"), opts_sizing = opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE) ) # Wilson interval for a binomial proportion. wilson <- function(x, n, z = 1.96) { p <- x / n d <- 1 + z^2 / n c <- (p + z^2 / (2 * n)) / d h <- (z / d) * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2)) c(lo = pmax(0, c - h), hi = pmin(1, c + h)) } ``` ::: ## 1. Introduction The previous post measured how often eligible college seasons end in an NFL outcome across all players at once, and since the draft sorts players by position first, this post splits those seasons by position and tests four expectations a fan might bring. + *Expecting quarterbacks to be the most draftable position.* + *Expecting first-round picks to concentrate among quarterbacks.* + *Expecting quarterbacks to be picked earliest on average, in every draft class.* + *Expecting quarterbacks to arrive through the draft while other positions lean on the undrafted route.* ## 2. Data ::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"} *Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-11-24. Draft classes after the last complete draft are right-censored and carry no outcomes, so they are excluded from every rate below rather than counted as failures. Each season's position comes from the roster table, joined by athlete id and season.* ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} outcomes <- tbl(con, "outcomes") |> collect() roster_pos <- tbl(con, "roster") |> # A few players carry two roster rows in one season (mid-season moves); # they always agree on the position, so one row per player-season is kept. select(playerId, season, position) |> distinct() |> collect() dbDisconnect(con) risk <- outcomes |> filter(draft_eligible, outcome_observed_d) |> mutate( across( c(outcome_drafted_d, outcome_signed_udfa_d, outcome_nfl_entry_d), ~ coalesce(.x, FALSE) ) ) |> left_join(roster_pos, by = c("playerId", "season")) pos_group <- c( QB = "Quarterback", RB = "Running back", FB = "Running back", WR = "Receiver", TE = "Tight end", T = "Offensive line", G = "Offensive line", C = "Offensive line", OL = "Offensive line", OT = "Offensive line", DL = "Defensive line", DE = "Defensive line", DT = "Defensive line", NT = "Defensive line", EDGE = "Defensive line", LB = "Linebacker", ILB = "Linebacker", OLB = "Linebacker", DB = "Defensive back", S = "Defensive back", CB = "Defensive back", PK = "Special teams", P = "Special teams", LS = "Special teams", PR = "Special teams" ) n_risk_pre <- nrow(risk) risk <- risk |> mutate( group = dplyr::coalesce( dplyr::recode(position, !!!pos_group, .default = "Position not recorded"), "Position not recorded" ) ) n_risk <- nrow(risk) n_players <- n_distinct(risk$playerId) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # thousands-separated and percent formatters for inline numbers fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) { formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits) } pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf("%.*f%%", digits, 100 * x) comparable <- function(df) filter(df, group != "Position not recorded") ``` ::: ### 2.1 Nine position groups stand in for two dozen roster codes Each season is counted at the roster position listed for it, and the table groups roster codes describing the same role into nine groups, plus a tenth for seasons with none recorded. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} group_terms <- tribble( ~Group , ~"Roster codes in the group" , "Quarterback" , "QB" , "Running back" , "RB, FB" , "Receiver" , "WR" , "Tight end" , "TE" , "Offensive line" , "T, G, C, OL, OT" , "Defensive line" , "DL, DE, DT, NT, EDGE" , "Linebacker" , "LB, ILB, OLB" , "Defensive back" , "DB, S, CB" , "Special teams" , "PK, P, LS, PR" , "Position not recorded" , "A placeholder code (?), the catch-all athlete code (ATH), or no roster row for that season at all" ) kable(group_terms, caption = "The position groups used throughout.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: The position groups used throughout. |Group |Roster codes in the group | |:---------------------|:-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| |Quarterback |QB | |Running back |RB, FB | |Receiver |WR | |Tight end |TE | |Offensive line |T, G, C, OL, OT | |Defensive line |DL, DE, DT, NT, EDGE | |Linebacker |LB, ILB, OLB | |Defensive back |DB, S, CB | |Special teams |PK, P, LS, PR | |Position not recorded |A placeholder code (?), the catch-all athlete code (ATH), or no roster row for that season at all | ::: ::: ### 2.2 The risk set is every eligible season whose draft outcome is already known A **player-season** is one season on a college roster, with or without a recorded stat line, and an **eligible** season is one whose following draft could have selected the player; the table counts the 108,232 eligible seasons, from 54,904 players, behind every rate below. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} risk_set <- tibble( Measure = c("Eligible player-seasons", "Distinct players"), Count = fmt(c(n_risk, n_players)) ) kable(risk_set, caption = "The risk set: eligible seasons with a known outcome.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: The risk set: eligible seasons with a known outcome. |Measure |Count | |:-----------------------|:-------| |Eligible player-seasons |108,232 | |Distinct players |54,904 | ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # The guarded position join adds or drops no rows, and the outcome labels # stay mutually exclusive after the join. ``` ::: ## 3. Results ### 3.1 Linemen and defensive backs edge the other groups in drafted rate, and quarterbacks sit mid-table ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} rates <- risk |> group_by(group) |> summarise( seasons = n(), players = n_distinct(playerId), drafted_ev = sum(outcome_drafted_d), .groups = "drop" ) |> dplyr::rowwise() |> mutate( drafted = drafted_ev / seasons, drafted_lo = 100 * wilson(drafted_ev, seasons)["lo"], drafted_hi = 100 * wilson(drafted_ev, seasons)["hi"] ) |> ungroup() |> arrange(desc(drafted)) rates_cmp <- comparable(rates) |> mutate(group_f = factor(group, levels = rev(group))) rate_of <- function(g) rates$drafted[rates$group == g] ol_rate <- rate_of("Offensive line") qb_rate <- rate_of("Quarterback") st_rate <- rate_of("Special teams") qb_rank <- which(rates_cmp$group == "Quarterback") top_group <- rates_cmp$group[1] top_rate <- rates_cmp$drafted[1] min_group <- rates_cmp$group[nrow(rates_cmp)] min_rate <- min(rates_cmp$drafted) # Groups whose interval reaches the leader's. overlap_top <- rates_cmp$group[-1][ rates_cmp$drafted_hi[-1] >= rates_cmp$drafted_lo[1] ] and_join <- function(x) sub(", ([^,]*)$", " and \\1", paste(x, collapse = ", ")) # The line counted only where a lineman left a stat line, as before the # roster population (decision 0050). ol_stat <- risk |> filter(group == "Offensive line", has_stat_line) ol_stat_rate <- mean(ol_stat$outcome_drafted_d) rate_class <- comparable(risk) |> group_by(group, draft_year) |> summarise(seasons = n(), drafted_ev = sum(outcome_drafted_d), .groups = "drop") |> mutate(drafted = drafted_ev / seasons) ``` ::: *Expecting quarterbacks to be the most draftable position.* ❌ The table and the first figure rank the groups by the share of eligible seasons ending in a draft pick, each with a 95 percent confidence interval (the range the true rate plausibly occupies, by Wilson's method): about 3.6 in every 100 defensive line seasons against 3 for quarterbacks (rank 4 of 9), and the defensive back, offensive line, quarterback, running back and tight end intervals all reach the defensive line's, so the leaders are close and quarterbacks are simply not ahead; the second figure follows each group's rate by draft class. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} rates_cmp |> transmute( `Position group` = group, `Eligible seasons` = fmt(seasons), Drafted = fmt(drafted_ev), Rate = pct(drafted), `95% CI` = sprintf("%.1f%% to %.1f%%", drafted_lo, drafted_hi) ) |> kable(caption = "Share of eligible seasons ending in a draft pick, by position group. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Share of eligible seasons ending in a draft pick, by position group. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted. |Position group |Eligible seasons |Drafted |Rate |95% CI | |:--------------|:----------------|:-------|:----|:------------| |Defensive line |15,997 |571 |3.6% |3.3% to 3.9% | |Defensive back |18,635 |640 |3.4% |3.2% to 3.7% | |Offensive line |15,595 |518 |3.3% |3.1% to 3.6% | |Quarterback |5,215 |159 |3.0% |2.6% to 3.6% | |Running back |8,805 |268 |3.0% |2.7% to 3.4% | |Tight end |6,390 |185 |2.9% |2.5% to 3.3% | |Receiver |15,084 |418 |2.8% |2.5% to 3.0% | |Linebacker |13,543 |373 |2.8% |2.5% to 3.0% | |Special teams |6,931 |58 |0.8% |0.6% to 1.1% | ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} qb_y <- which(levels(rates_cmp$group_f) == "Quarterback") x_max <- max(rates_cmp$drafted_hi) top3 <- rates_cmp$group[1:3] p_rates <- ggplot(rates_cmp, aes(100 * drafted, group_f)) + geom_col_interactive( aes( fill = case_when( group %in% top3 ~ "lead", group == "Quarterback" ~ "qb", TRUE ~ "other" ), tooltip = sprintf( "%s: %.1f%% drafted (%s of %s eligible seasons; 95%% CI %.1f%% to %.1f%%)", group, 100 * drafted, fmt(drafted_ev), fmt(seasons), drafted_lo, drafted_hi ), data_id = group ), width = 0.7 ) + geom_linerange(aes(xmin = drafted_lo, xmax = drafted_hi), linewidth = 0.8) + geom_text( aes( x = drafted_hi + 0.05, label = sprintf( "%.1f%% (%s of %s)", 100 * drafted, fmt(drafted_ev), fmt(seasons) ) ), hjust = 0, size = 4.2 ) + annotate( "text", x = x_max + 1.1, y = qb_y - 1.6, label = sprintf( "Quarterbacks rank %d of %d:\n%.1f%% of eligible seasons drafted", qb_rank, nrow(rates_cmp), 100 * qb_rate ), size = 4.2, hjust = 0 ) + annotate( "curve", x = x_max + 1.05, y = qb_y - 1.1, xend = rates_cmp$drafted_hi[rates_cmp$group == "Quarterback"] + 0.85, yend = qb_y - 0.1, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.6 ) + expand_limits(x = x_max + 2.6) + scale_x_continuous( labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02)) ) + scale_fill_manual(values = c(lead = "#1B9E77", qb = "#D95F02", other = "gray65")) + guides(fill = "none") + labs( title = sprintf( "%s lead at %.1f%% to %.1f%% of eligible seasons drafted", and_join(top3), 100 * min(rates_cmp$drafted[1:3]), 100 * max(rates_cmp$drafted[1:3]) ), subtitle = "Share of eligible player-seasons ending in a draft pick, by position group", x = "Eligible seasons drafted", y = NULL, caption = "Whiskers: 95% confidence interval. Labels: drafted seasons of eligible seasons. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_rates, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p_rate_class <- ggplot(rate_class, aes(draft_year, 100 * drafted, color = group)) + geom_line_interactive(aes(data_id = group, tooltip = group), linewidth = 1.1) + geom_point_interactive( aes( data_id = group, tooltip = sprintf( "%s, %d class: %.1f%% drafted (%s of %s eligible seasons)", group, draft_year, 100 * drafted, fmt(drafted_ev), fmt(seasons) ) ), size = 2.2 ) + scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired") + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(risk$draft_year), max(risk$draft_year), 2)) + labs( title = "Each group's drafted rate, class by class", subtitle = "Share of eligible seasons ending in a draft pick, by position group and draft class", x = "Draft class", y = "Eligible seasons drafted (%)", color = NULL, caption = "Hover a line to isolate a group; hover a point for the counts." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() + theme(legend.position = "right") girafe(ggobj = p_rate_class, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ::: ### 3.2 Drafted quarterbacks go in the first round more often than any other group ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} round_mix <- risk |> filter(outcome_drafted_d) |> group_by(group) |> summarise( drafted_seasons = n(), round1 = sum(outcome_draft_round_d == 1L), .groups = "drop" ) |> mutate(round1_share = round1 / drafted_seasons) |> arrange(desc(round1_share)) round_cmp <- comparable(round_mix) |> mutate(group_f = factor(group, levels = rev(group))) qb_r1 <- round_mix[round_mix$group == "Quarterback", ] runner_up <- round_cmp[2, ] cast_pick <- function(name, col) { risk[[col]][risk$player == name & risk$outcome_drafted_d] } burrow_pick <- cast_pick("Joe Burrow", "outcome_draft_pick_d") ward_pick <- cast_pick("Cameron Ward", "outcome_draft_pick_d") travis_round <- cast_pick("Jordan Travis", "outcome_draft_round_d") travis_pick <- cast_pick("Jordan Travis", "outcome_draft_pick_d") ``` ::: *Expecting first-round picks to concentrate among quarterbacks.* ✅ The table and the first figure give the share of each group's drafted seasons that went in round 1, led by quarterbacks at 25.2% (Joe Burrow and Cameron Ward among them, both first overall) against 16.2% for offensive line; the second figure shows every group's full round mix, where Jordan Travis's round-5 selection counts the same in the drafted rate as Burrow's. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} round_cmp |> transmute( `Position group` = group, `Drafted seasons` = drafted_seasons, `Round 1` = round1, `Round 1 share` = pct(round1_share) ) |> kable(caption = "First-round picks among each group's drafted seasons. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: First-round picks among each group's drafted seasons. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted. |Position group | Drafted seasons| Round 1|Round 1 share | |:--------------|---------------:|-------:|:-------------| |Quarterback | 159| 40|25.2% | |Offensive line | 518| 84|16.2% | |Defensive line | 571| 90|15.8% | |Receiver | 418| 60|14.4% | |Linebacker | 373| 42|11.3% | |Defensive back | 640| 72|11.2% | |Tight end | 185| 14|7.6% | |Running back | 268| 16|6.0% | |Special teams | 58| 0|0.0% | ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} r1_qb_y <- which(levels(round_cmp$group_f) == "Quarterback") p_round <- ggplot(round_cmp, aes(100 * round1_share, group_f)) + geom_col_interactive( aes( fill = group == "Quarterback", tooltip = sprintf( "%s: %d of %d drafted seasons in round 1 (%.1f%%)", group, round1, drafted_seasons, 100 * round1_share ), data_id = group ), width = 0.7 ) + geom_text( aes( label = sprintf( "%.1f%% (%d of %d)", 100 * round1_share, round1, drafted_seasons ) ), hjust = -0.08, size = 4.2 ) + annotate( "text", x = 100 * qb_r1$round1_share - 1.6, y = r1_qb_y - 2.4, label = sprintf( "%.1f%% of drafted quarterbacks\ngo in the first round", 100 * qb_r1$round1_share ), size = 4.2, hjust = 0 ) + annotate( "curve", x = 100 * qb_r1$round1_share + 1.4, y = r1_qb_y - 1.9, xend = 100 * qb_r1$round1_share - 1, yend = r1_qb_y - 0.38, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.6 ) + expand_limits(x = 100 * qb_r1$round1_share + 14) + scale_x_continuous( labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02)) ) + scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D95F02", `FALSE` = "gray65")) + guides(fill = "none") + labs( title = "Quarterbacks claim the first round out of proportion", subtitle = "Share of each group's drafted seasons that were first-round picks", x = "Drafted seasons picked in round 1", y = NULL, caption = "Labels: round-1 picks of drafted seasons. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_round, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} round_dist <- comparable(risk) |> filter(outcome_drafted_d) |> count(group, round = outcome_draft_round_d, name = "n") |> group_by(group) |> mutate(share = n / sum(n)) |> ungroup() |> mutate( group = factor(group, levels = levels(round_cmp$group_f)), round = factor(round, levels = 7:1) ) p_round_dist <- ggplot(round_dist, aes(100 * share, group, fill = round)) + geom_col_interactive( aes( tooltip = sprintf( "%s, round %s: %d of the group's drafted seasons (%.1f%%)", group, round, n, 100 * share ), data_id = paste(group, round) ), width = 0.7 ) + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "YlGnBu", direction = -1, breaks = as.character(1:7)) + scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) + labs( title = "Every group's full round mix", subtitle = "Share of each group's drafted seasons by draft round", x = "Share of drafted seasons", y = NULL, fill = "Round", caption = "Hover a segment for the count." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_round_dist, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ::: ### 3.3 Quarterbacks carry the earliest average pick across classes, but not in most single classes ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pick_trend <- risk |> filter(outcome_drafted_d, !is.na(outcome_draft_pick_d)) |> group_by(group, draft_year) |> summarise( picks = n(), avg_pick = mean(outcome_draft_pick_d), .groups = "drop" ) |> filter(picks >= 5) |> comparable() pooled_pick <- mean(risk$outcome_draft_pick_d[ risk$outcome_drafted_d & !is.na(risk$outcome_draft_pick_d) ]) complete_groups <- pick_trend |> count(group) |> filter(n == max(n)) |> pull(group) group_means <- pick_trend |> filter(group %in% complete_groups) |> group_by(group) |> summarise(m = mean(avg_pick), .groups = "drop") qb_avg_all <- group_means$m[group_means$group == "Quarterback"] lowest_per_year <- pick_trend |> group_by(draft_year) |> slice_min(avg_pick, n = 1) |> ungroup() n_classes <- nrow(lowest_per_year) n_qb_lowest <- sum(lowest_per_year$group == "Quarterback") qb_trend <- pick_trend |> filter(group == "Quarterback") |> mutate( lowest = draft_year %in% lowest_per_year$draft_year[lowest_per_year$group == "Quarterback"] ) first_lowest <- qb_trend |> filter(lowest) |> slice_min(avg_pick, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) ``` ::: *Expecting quarterbacks to be picked earliest on average, in every draft class.* ❌ The table and the first figure trace each group's average overall pick: over all classes quarterbacks sit at pick 115, the earliest of the 8 groups with enough picks in every class, yet they hold the earliest average in only 5 of 14 classes; the second figure shows every individual pick behind those averages. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pick_trend |> group_by(`Position group` = group) |> summarise( `Classes with 5 or more picks` = n(), `Average pick across classes` = round(mean(avg_pick)), `Classes with the earliest average` = sum( paste(group, draft_year) %in% paste(lowest_per_year$group, lowest_per_year$draft_year) ), .groups = "drop" ) |> arrange(`Average pick across classes`) |> kable(caption = "Average overall pick by position group, over the group-class cells with at least five picks.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Average overall pick by position group, over the group-class cells with at least five picks. |Position group | Classes with 5 or more picks| Average pick across classes| Classes with the earliest average| |:--------------|----------------------------:|---------------------------:|---------------------------------:| |Quarterback | 14| 115| 5| |Defensive line | 14| 118| 2| |Offensive line | 14| 120| 1| |Receiver | 14| 122| 2| |Defensive back | 14| 127| 0| |Tight end | 14| 127| 1| |Linebacker | 14| 128| 2| |Running back | 14| 140| 1| |Special teams | 5| 179| 0| ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p_pick <- ggplot(pick_trend, aes(draft_year, avg_pick)) + geom_hline(yintercept = pooled_pick, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") + geom_line_interactive( data = filter(pick_trend, group != "Quarterback"), aes(group = group, tooltip = group, data_id = group), color = "gray75", linewidth = 0.9 ) + geom_line(data = qb_trend, color = "#D95F02", linewidth = 1.4) + geom_point_interactive( data = qb_trend, aes( shape = lowest, tooltip = sprintf( "Quarterbacks, %d: pick %.0f on average (%d picks)", draft_year, avg_pick, picks ) ), color = "#D95F02", fill = "#D95F02", size = 3.4, stroke = 1.2 ) + scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 21, `FALSE` = 1), guide = "none") + annotate( "text", x = min(qb_trend$draft_year) + 0.2, y = 22, label = sprintf( "Filled points: the %d of %d classes where\nquarterbacks had the earliest average pick", n_qb_lowest, n_classes ), size = 4.2, hjust = 0 ) + annotate( "curve", x = min(qb_trend$draft_year) + 5.6, y = 26, xend = first_lowest$draft_year - 0.2, yend = first_lowest$avg_pick - 6, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.6 ) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(qb_trend$draft_year), max(qb_trend$draft_year), by = 2)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) + labs( title = "The quarterback average swings by dozens of picks from class to class", subtitle = "Average overall pick among drafted seasons, by draft class (lower is earlier)", x = "Draft class", y = "Average overall pick", caption = sprintf( "Orange: quarterbacks. Gray: the other position groups (hover for names).\nDashed line: all drafted seasons, pick %.0f. Discussion ::: {.callout-important appearance="minimal"} **Which offensive linemen are counted decides where the offensive line ranks.** - All 7,787 rostered offensive linemen are counted, and their 3.3% drafted rate sits within the leading pack. - Only 11% of their eligible seasons carry a stat line; counted alone, those seasons are drafted at 7.1%, which would top every group in the table above, likely because a lineman who leaves a statistical trace is one who plays. ::: ::: {.callout-important appearance="minimal"} **Position is a feature the models should carry.** - Both the level (drafted rates from 0.8% for special teams to 3.6% for the defensive line) and the shape (round mix, average pick, entry route) differ by position. - A single pooled model would spend its capacity explaining variance that position names in one column. ::: Two caveats bound the figures. The not-recorded group holds 2,037 seasons, 1.9% of the risk set, mostly placeholder position codes in the 2013 to 2018 classes and missing roster rows, most often in the earliest classes and in 2021 and 2022; it is counted in the risk set but left out of the comparisons. And the eligibility-clock imputation noted in the previous post applies here: for players without a recruiting record, high-school graduation is dated to their first college season in the data, so their clock can start early or late and move seasons in or out of the risk set. These players are a similar share of every group except special teams, so the comparisons among the other groups are sturdier than the absolute levels.
